title: Omni2Web: Benchmarking Audiovisual Website Development
abstract: arXiv:2609.23417v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Screen-recorded web editing requests contain weak deictic expressions such as ``this'' and ``there,'' whose referents depend on speech, cursor trajectories, page state, and edit history. Such requests require intent recovery beyond the explicit specifications assumed by many existing web-editing benchmarks. We introduce Omni2Web, a bilingual benchmark of 918 instances spanning 13,907 edit steps. It defines three complementary tracks: Direct Editing evaluates webpage editing from recordings, Instruction Recovery measures explicit intent recovery, and Instruction Utility tests whether recovered instructions can drive a fixed code executor. We evaluate 17 open- and closed-source models. The best models attain 51.17 on the Edit Fidelity Score (EFS) for Direct Editing and 49.14 on the Instruction Recovery Score (IRS); under the fixed executor, the strongest recovered instructions reach 51.08 EFS, still far below the 89.69 EFS obtained with or

translated_title: Omni2Web：视听化网页开发基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.23417v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：屏幕录制的网页编辑请求中包含诸如“这个”和“那里”等弱指示性表达，其所指对象依赖于语音、光标轨迹、页面状态和编辑历史。此类请求所需的意图恢复能力超出了许多现有网页编辑基准所假设的显式规范。我们提出了Omni2Web，一个包含918个实例、涵盖13,907个编辑步骤的双语基准。该基准定义了三个互补的评测轨道：直接编辑评估从录屏中直接进行网页编辑的能力，指令恢复衡量显式意图恢复的能力，指令实用性测试恢复出的指令能否驱动一个固定的代码执行器。我们评估了17个开源和闭源模型。最好的模型在直接编辑轨道的编辑保真度得分上达到51.17，在指令恢复得分（IRS）上达到49.14；在固定执行器下，最强的恢复指令达到51.08 EFS，仍远低于使用真值所获得的89.69 EFS。
tldr: 提出双语基准Omni2Web，通过直接编辑、指令恢复和指令实用性三个互补轨道，评测模型从包含弱指示表达的音视频录屏中理解并执行网页编辑的能力，发现现有最优模型的性能仍远低于真值水平。
en_tdlr: Omni2Web is a bilingual benchmark of 918 audiovisual instances that evaluates models on directly editing webpages from screen recordings, recovering explicit instructions, and driving a fixed code executor with those instructions, revealing that even the best models still fall far short of oracle performance.
